title: claude-sub in production: wiring, the cloud routing rule, and a current claude CLI in the image
description: Follow-up of jvj (docs/spikes/jvj-claude-sub-cloud.md, PR #243), operator 2026-10-06 'yes please': (1) production wiring of the claude-sub rung: Worker secrets CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> (operator sets them; deploy/doctor report which labels exist, never values), the per-subscription cap of 2, quota/rate-limit handling and the Workers AI fallback; (2) the cloud routing rule (tick nwn, CloudRule in internal/profile/cloudworker.go) changes from 'Workers AI models only' to 'no per-token billing in the cloud': subscription rungs only with the versionless claude aliases (sonnet, opus) and each naming a Workers AI fallback; (3) the claude CLI in the production worker image, with an automatic pin bump (scheduled CI job/PR that moves CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION to the latest release) so the aliases resolve to the latest models (2.1.227 maps opus to claude-opus-5; current releases map it to 5.5); (4) ladder: implement sonnet → opus, review/closeout opus. Off unless a config selects it (tda).
acceptance_criteria: [1] A production cloud run whose config selects claude-sub runs a review on opus via the subscription, token never in the container, falls back to Workers AI when no subscription is free. [2] CloudRule enforces the new rule with tests. [3] A scheduled job keeps the image's claude CLI current. [4] make gate + cloudflare tests pass.
